name: Nexscope - One Amazon Product to Google Sheets (manual starter)

nodes.name: Append to Google Sheets - configure then enable

parameters.content:
## Configure before running
1. Set the ASIN in Product input.
2. Select a Header Auth credential on the HTTP node: Authorization = Bearer YOUR_KEY. Never put a key in this JSON.
3. First run with Sheets disabled; inspect Validate and map.
4. Create the sheet headers from the companion CSV. Select your own Google credential, spreadsheet and sheet. Keep RAW cell format. Enable the Sheets node only when ready to append.
5. Manual execution only, no automatic retry. A repeated run can charge credits and append a duplicate row. Check and unpin all sample data before a real run.
